newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan newspaper forecasts Honda profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Japan newspaper forecasts Honda profit rise.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd is expected to post a record group profit of 245 billion yen ($2.04 billion) in the current fiscal year to the end of next March, up 11 percent from 1996, a major financial newspaper reported on Saturday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the profit forecast was based on rising sales of vehicles, both in Japan and overseas, a weaker yen and cost cutting achieved through restructuring of operations.
A Honda spokesman had no comment on the report.
The newspaper said company forecasts showed sales of vehicles overseas were especially robust in the United States and Asia.
It said the sales forecast outside of Japan was for 1.5 million units, up from 1.42 million in fiscal 1996.
In Japan, sales may dip in response to a national rise in consumption or sales tax.
But the newspaper said Honda's new sports-utility mini-vehicles, unveiled last month, were selling well.
